comparison.objective: Intercept two moving slot cars with assigned arms and place them on matching pads.
comparison.physical_skill: Timed bimanual interception, extraction from guides and coordinated placement around a moving distractor.
comparison.success_condition: Both targets validly extracted while moving and placed; forbidden contact or premature stopping fails.
comparison.reason: Tests high-speed interception and assignment-specific bimanual coordination, not maintenance-tool manipulation or mechanism tuning. No separate spec versions were present; the body supplied the rubric.
